_about: Neverwhere shot list: the audited prompt for every video clip (and, later, every still). Each shot: scene, cast (exactly the beat's cast), location, keyframe (the first frame), motion (the 5 seconds), seconds, source (the novel lines it is checked against), audited (true once it passed scripts/audit-shots.mjs and a second reading against the novel). The keyframe is built from production/neverwhere-cast.json: approved sheets as references, lock texts leading the prompt.

nw-2.1-beast-dream-v.location: The labyrinth under London: old brick sewer tunnels opening into the Fleet Marsh, a floor of mud and foul standing water, whining mosquitoes, lit only by a fitful yellow-amber flare.
nw-2.1-beast-dream-v.keyframe: POV of a dreamer standing in a Victorian brick sewer: the Great Beast of London fills the tunnel ahead completely: a boar the size of a bull elephant, its bristled back scraping the curved brick roof and its shoulders brushing both walls, so that almost nothing of the tunnel shows around it, massive head down, black-brown bristled hide stuck with broken spears and blades, two curved tusks rising from the lower jaw, small red eyes, breath steaming in the cold. In the lower frame the dreamer's own hand grips a spear: the arm furred with dark hair, the nails almost claws.
nw-2.1-beast-dream-v.motion: Almost still for two seconds (it pauses 'for a hundred years'): steam drifts, water drips. Then the Beast lowers its head and charges in dreamlike slow motion, drops of water hanging in the air; the spear is thrown, too late; the tusks fill the frame and it cuts to black.
nw-2.1-beast-dream-v.source: bridge; the dream, novel ch. 1 lines 750-762
nw-2.1-beast-dream-v.why: The recurring nightmare is the spine of the book: it opens the bridge from the Sandman, returns as the dead end at 19.2 and comes true at 19.1.
nw-2.1-beast-dream-v.scale: Scale: People and creatures: the Great Beast of London 3.2 m (at the shoulder, about 6 m long). Brick tunnels about 4 m high and 4 m wide: a standing person reaches less than half way to the roof; the Beast's back nearly scrapes it. Every person at true adult proportions (head about one-eighth of height); camera at adult eye level unless the shot says otherwise.
nw-2.1-beast-dream-v.newPlace: the dream itself, seen as a vision (Lucienne's report in 0.1; Aurie's nightmare in 2.1)

nw-0.2-threshold-v.location: Lucienne's library between worlds: tall dark bookshelves of books that were never written, a long wooden reading table with an oil lantern, drifting dust and sand, and in the far wall a row of doors from other stories: a dark plank door marked NEVERWHERE, a pale blue door marked CORALINE, a rough wooden door marked THE ALCHEMIST, a white door standing ajar on mist.
nw-0.2-threshold-v.keyframe: From behind and slightly to one side, medium-wide: Aurie as Dream of the Endless in her long black high-collared gown with a faint starry shimmer, raven-black hair down her back, stands before a lone wooden door in the dim library, her hand on the handle. The door has just begun to open: a slice of wet street light, rain and warm pub-window glow spills across the floorboards.
nw-0.2-threshold-v.motion: The door swings slowly inward; rain-light and a few blown drops wash over the gown; she steps through, back to camera, and the library behind her stays dark. Plays forward once.
nw-0.2-threshold-v.source: bridge (bridges.md); the pub in the rain, novel prologue lines 25-45
nw-0.2-threshold-v.why: The threshold between the two books: one doorway shot carries the reader from the Sandman into Neverwhere.
nw-0.2-threshold-v.scale: Scale: People and creatures: Aurie 1.65 m. Shelves about 5 m tall; each door an ordinary 2.1 m door; the reading table waist-high. Every person at true adult proportions (head about one-eighth of height); camera at adult eye level unless the shot says otherwise.

nw-1.2-fall-v.location: A London pavement at night beside a high blank brick wall, street lamps, wet paving stones.
nw-1.2-fall-v.keyframe: Wide shot of a high blank brick wall under a street lamp. A door stands open in the brickwork where no door was. In it is Door: a pretty British Chinese woman of about twenty-two, petite, short choppy near-black hair with copper lights, filthy, blood-stained and tangled, the enormous brown leather flying jacket over a laced patchwork corset bodice, short layered rag skirt, laddered stockings, black boots; her face crusted with dirt and blood.
nw-1.2-fall-v.motion: She sways for one long terrible moment, then folds onto the pavement face down in her bulky jacket. Behind her the doorway is gone: the wall is blank, unbroken brick again.
nw-1.2-fall-v.source: novel ch. 1 lines 628-697 (the wall blank and unbroken, 669)
nw-1.2-fall-v.why: The inciting incident; the wall closing behind her shows the magic before a word is spoken.
nw-1.2-fall-v.scale: Scale: People and creatures: Door 1.52 m. The brick wall is about 4 m high; the door that opens in it is ordinary size, about 2 m. Every person at true adult proportions (head about one-eighth of height); camera at adult eye level unless the shot says otherwise.

nw-3.1-rags-v.location: Orme Passage: a narrow alley that should not exist, one hissing gas jet, wet cobbles, a metal dustbin at the dead end.
nw-3.1-rags-v.keyframe: Medium-wide from behind Aurie's shoulder: Aurie in her suit (rumpled black trouser suit, white shirt, black coat) at the dead end of the gaslit alley, her arm just releasing a crumpled ball of paper toward a metal dustbin; beside the bin lies what looks like a pile of black rags: it is the marquis de Carabas, curled up and hidden under his huge black coat.
nw-3.1-rags-v.motion: The pile of rags unfolds, expands and stands up in one fluid motion, and a hand catches the paper in midair: the marquis de Carabas, a tall lean Black British man, very dark skin, long locs tied back, the huge black dandy's coat with torn lace cuffs over raggedy layers, high black boots; his eyes and his sudden white grin flash in the gaslight. Aurie stays still, startled but calm.
nw-3.1-rags-v.why: The marquis's entrance is the novel's best reveal and needs motion: rags becoming a man.
nw-3.1-rags-v.scale: Scale: People and creatures: Aurie 1.65 m; the marquis de Carabas 1.88 m, about one head taller than Aurie. The alley is about 2 m wide; the dustbin is waist-high (about 1 m); the gas jet bracket is about 2.5 m up the wall. Every person at true adult proportions (head about one-eighth of height); camera at adult eye level unless the shot says otherwise.

nw-4.1-sleeve-v.location: A crowded London Underground platform, Monday morning rush hour, curved tiled walls, a train at the platform.
nw-4.1-sleeve-v.keyframe: Medium-wide, side-on, beside a Tube train: Aurie in her suit (black trouser suit, white shirt, black coat) has one arm inside the carriage as the doors hiss shut on her coat sleeve; her briefcase in the other hand; commuters push past, none looking at her.
nw-4.1-sleeve-v.motion: The train pulls away; Aurie is dragged along the platform, stumbling faster and faster, drops the briefcase, tugs at the trapped sleeve; it rips and she falls forward onto the platform as the train is gone. Nobody turns. Seen side-on and from behind; her face strained but not distorted.
nw-4.1-sleeve-v.why: The first physical proof that she has fallen out of the world: it hurts, and no one sees.
nw-4.1-sleeve-v.scale: Scale: People and creatures: Aurie 1.65 m. Tube carriage doors are about 1.9 m high: a standing adult's head comes close to the top of the door. Every person at true adult proportions (head about one-eighth of height); camera at adult eye level unless the shot says otherwise.

nw-4.3-door-v.location: Aurie's small rented flat at night: the narrow hallway and front door, stairwell light beyond.
nw-4.3-door-v.keyframe: From behind Aurie, in her suit (rumpled black trouser suit, white shirt), standing in her dark hallway with a telephone receiver in her hand; ahead of her the front door is swinging open on its own. In the stairwell light stand Mr Croup (thin, pallid, lank greasy orange hair, faded china-blue eyes, graveyard grin, greasy black suit whose seams are subtly wrong) and Mr Vandemar (huge, bristle-cut grey-and-black hair, blank face, the same suit, raven-skull rings on his right hand).
nw-4.3-door-v.motion: The door finishes opening; Croup's grin widens; Vandemar steps in and his shadow falls over her; she lets the receiver drop. Cut to black before anything happens.
nw-4.3-door-v.source: dead end (dead-2.2); Croup and Vandemar as drawn in novel ch. 1 lines 860-880
nw-4.3-door-v.why: Dead ends are on video (rule): giving Door away twice has a price.
nw-4.3-door-v.scale: Scale: People and creatures: Aurie 1.65 m; Mr Croup 1.68 m, about the same height as Aurie; Mr Vandemar 2.05 m, about one and a half heads taller than Aurie. The hallway is about 1 m wide; the front door about 2 m high; a wall telephone at shoulder height. Every person at true adult proportions (head about one-eighth of height); camera at adult eye level unless the shot says otherwise.

nw-shared-death-v.location: A quiet grey nowhere at the edge of a dream: completely empty, no buildings, ruins, doors or furniture, only soft grey mist over a smooth pale grey floor, fading to white with no horizon, soft even light.
nw-shared-death-v.keyframe: Medium shot: Death exactly as in her Sandman sheet, in black, a silver ankh at her throat, standing in soft grey light with a small kind smile, one hand held out.
nw-shared-death-v.motion: She tilts her head and says two gentle sentences, lips moving softly; lowers her hand; the light behind her brightens slowly to white. Ends near the first frame.
nw-shared-death-v.source: dead end (shared by every dead end); added from the Sandman
nw-shared-death-v.why: One shared clip for every dead end: her sister sends her back, so each dead end costs one clip, not two.
nw-shared-death-v.scale: Scale: People and creatures: Death 1.65 m. No objects at all; the mist begins a few metres away; a person stands at ordinary height, camera at adult eye level. Every person at true adult proportions (head about one-eighth of height); camera at adult eye level unless the shot says otherwise.
nw-shared-death-v.newPlace: after a death: the grey edge of the dream where her sister waits

nw-5.3-hall-v.location: The Rat-speakers' hall under London: greasy fires, rat holes in every wall, people lying prostrate before a single rat.
nw-5.3-hall-v.keyframe: Medium-wide by firelight: Aurie in her sweater (black cable-knit sweater, black jeans, black sports bag on her shoulder) reaches for a glass dagger on a trestle; across it the Lord Rat-speaker (tall, permanently stooped, long greasy hair, patchy beard, calico-fur-trimmed rags) watches, fingertips pressed together; on the trestle Master Longtail, a large old dark brown rat with a long pink tail, a grizzled muzzle and a torn left ear, turns his head away.
nw-5.3-hall-v.motion: Her hand closes on the glass; the Rat-speaker's hand closes over hers first, slow and certain; the rat does not move; the fires gutter and the frame darkens.
nw-5.3-hall-v.source: dead end (dead-2.4); the hall, novel ch. 4 lines 2076-2125; Longtail of the clan Gray, dark brown, 1134, 2061
nw-5.3-hall-v.why: Dead end on video: rudeness to a rat in the rats' own hall.
nw-5.3-hall-v.scale: Scale: People and creatures: Aurie 1.65 m; the Lord Rat-speaker 1.85 m (permanently stooped, so he stands about 1.65 m), about one head taller than Aurie; Master Longtail 0.3 m (nose to rump, the tail as long again). Rat holes are fist-sized; a rat is about 25 to 30 cm nose to rump; trestles are waist-high. Every person at true adult proportions (head about one-eighth of height); camera at adult eye level unless the shot says otherwise.

nw-5.4-journal-v.location: The study in the House Without Doors: a stuffed crocodile on the ceiling, an astrolabe, a bust of Portico, a brown stain; on the desk the journal machine, a cabinet of walnut, brass and prisms with a gramophone horn and a small screen.
nw-5.4-journal-v.keyframe: Over the shoulders of Door (short choppy near-black hair with copper lights, the enormous brown leather flying jacket, washed) and the marquis de Carabas (huge black dandy's coat, long locs tied back) toward the journal machine: on its small flickering screen Lord Portico, a thin British Chinese man of about sixty with Door's heart-shaped face, almost bald, his skullcap gone, wearing a long coat, a scarlet gash down one side of his head, speaks urgently; behind him on screen a desk and a blank white wall.
nw-5.4-journal-v.motion: Portico wipes the blood from his eyes and speaks; a bang from the horn; he turns his head offscreen, puzzled and nervous, and steps out of frame. The picture holds on the empty desk and white wall for a beat, then an arc of vivid blood splashes across the wall. Door's hand flicks a lever and the screen goes blank; the marquis holds out a handkerchief.
nw-5.4-journal-v.source: novel ch. 3 lines 2665-2700 (the last entry: long coat, skullcap gone, 2667-2669)
nw-5.4-journal-v.why: The murder of Door's family is only ever seen on this little screen; the blood on the white wall is the image that drives the whole quest.
nw-5.4-journal-v.scale: Scale: People and creatures: Lord Portico 1.72 m; Door 1.52 m, about one head shorter than Lord Portico; the marquis de Carabas 1.88 m, about half a head taller than Lord Portico. The desk is waist-high; the journal machine's screen is about the size of a hardback book; the crocodile on the ceiling is about 3 m long. Every person at true adult proportions (head about one-eighth of height); camera at adult eye level unless the shot says otherwise.

nw-6.2-dark-v.location: Night's Bridge: a narrow medieval stone span into total black, no sky, no water.
nw-6.2-dark-v.keyframe: POV from the first stones of a medieval bridge into absolute blackness: a candle in a lemonade bottle held out in a hand in a black sweater sleeve, its small flame the only light; a girl's thin hand grips the other hand at the edge of frame; the stones vanish three steps ahead.
nw-6.2-dark-v.motion: The dark thickens until it seems to touch the lens. Shapes rise and fade in it: a woman's contemptuous face, a burning figure falling, a labyrinth of tunnels, a spear, a huge boar charging agonizingly slowly out of the black, again and again. The girl's hand shakes, then slips away. The candle flares so bright the frame burns white.
nw-6.2-dark-v.why: The most frightening place in the book is pure darkness; only video can turn the dark up.
nw-6.2-dark-v.scale: Scale: The bridge is about 2 m wide with waist-high (about 1 m) stone parapets. Every person at true adult proportions (head about one-eighth of height); camera at adult eye level unless the shot says otherwise.

nw-6.3-beads-v.location: Night's Bridge: a narrow medieval stone span into total black, no sky, no water.
nw-6.3-beads-v.keyframe: Medium-wide from behind Aurie in her sweater (black cable-knit sweater, black jeans) at the end of the stone bridge, her empty hand open at her side; beside her Hunter (tall Asian woman, very long dark braid fading to tawny bronze, thin sleeveless dappled suede top, leather leggings, quarterstaff) raises her wrist torch toward the crown of the bridge.
nw-6.3-beads-v.motion: A handful of irregular quartz beads patters down the curve of the bridge toward them, bouncing in the torch beam; Aurie crouches and picks one up; Hunter sweeps the light across the whole bridge: it is deserted.
nw-6.3-beads-v.why: Anaesthesia's death is told only by the beads; the bead in Aurie's pocket saves her in 14.1.
nw-6.3-beads-v.scale: Scale: People and creatures: Aurie 1.65 m; Hunter 1.78 m, about half a head taller than Aurie. The bridge is about 2 m wide with waist-high (about 1 m) stone parapets. Every person at true adult proportions (head about one-eighth of height); camera at adult eye level unless the shot says otherwise.

nw-6.4-bridge-v.location: Night's Bridge: a narrow medieval stone span into total black, no sky, no water.
nw-6.4-bridge-v.keyframe: Wide shot: Hunter alone at the far end of Night's Bridge (tall Asian woman, long braid down her back, dappled suede, quarterstaff), wrist torch lit; behind her the stone span disappears into total black; at her feet a few scattered quartz beads.
nw-6.4-bridge-v.motion: She looks back once into the dark, then turns and walks on alone out of frame; the torchlight goes with her and the bridge sinks into blackness.
nw-6.4-bridge-v.source: dead end (dead-2.6); the bridge, novel ch. 4 lines 2880-2895
nw-6.4-bridge-v.why: Dead end on video: the bridge takes two.
nw-6.4-bridge-v.scale: Scale: People and creatures: Hunter 1.78 m. The bridge is about 2 m wide with waist-high (about 1 m) stone parapets. Every person at true adult proportions (head about one-eighth of height); camera at adult eye level unless the shot says otherwise.

nw-8.1-crowbar-v.location: The Floating Market in Harrods' Egyptian Room at night: thousands of lights, stalls set on the shop counters, curry smoke, open fires, a jostling crowd of London Below.
nw-8.1-crowbar-v.keyframe: Medium-wide in the market: Varney (huge, shaven head, ruined teeth, patched car-seat jacket, tattoos) staggering to his feet with a crowbar drawn back to throw; in the foreground Hunter (tall Asian woman, long dark braid fading to bronze, thin sleeveless dappled suede top, leather leggings) stands talking to Door (short choppy copper-lit hair, brown leather flying jacket, patchwork corset bodice), with Aurie in her sweater (black cable-knit sweater, black jeans) beside Door and the marquis de Carabas (huge black dandy's coat) a step behind; Hunter is not looking at Varney.
nw-8.1-crowbar-v.motion: Varney hurls the crowbar at Hunter's head; without turning, Hunter reaches out a hand and catches it, thwap, in her palm. The marquis watches, unmoved; the ghost of a smile on Door's lips. Hunter walks over to Varney, the bar in her hand.
nw-8.1-crowbar-v.why: Hunter's introduction in one move: the catch tells us everything about her.
nw-8.1-crowbar-v.scale: Scale: People and creatures: Hunter 1.78 m, about half a head taller than Aurie; Varney 1.95 m, about one and a half heads taller than Aurie; Door 1.52 m, about half a head shorter than Aurie; the marquis de Carabas 1.88 m, about one head taller than Aurie; Aurie 1.65 m. Shop counters are waist-high (about 1 m); the hall's ceiling is about 6 m. Every person at true adult proportions (head about one-eighth of height); camera at adult eye level unless the shot says otherwise.

nw-8.3-stairs-v.location: The bottom of a disused Tube station's spiral staircase: metal railings, a sign warning of 259 steps, steel lift doors.
nw-8.3-stairs-v.keyframe: Low angle at the bottom of a dark spiral staircase beside closed lift doors and a sign warning of 259 steps: Varney (huge, shaven head, patched car-seat jacket, empty machete sheath on his shoulder) stumbles down the last turn, panting; high above, a glimpse of Mr Croup's lank orange hair over the railing; in the deep shadow of the bottom step sits Mr Vandemar (huge, blank face, wrong black suit, raven-skull rings), barely visible.
nw-8.3-stairs-v.motion: The lift doors clank and open magnificently slowly, flooding the passage with light; Varney gropes for his machete: gone. A polite cough. He turns: Mr Vandemar on the bottom step, paring his nails with Varney's machete. A blur of black falls from above: Mr Croup, all teeth. Cut to black.
nw-8.3-stairs-v.why: The two gentlemen at their most dreadful and most funny; the slow lift doors are the joke.
nw-8.3-stairs-v.scale: Scale: People and creatures: Varney 1.95 m; Mr Vandemar 2.05 m, about half a head taller than Varney; Mr Croup 1.68 m, about one head shorter than Varney. Each step about 18 cm high; railings waist-high; the lift doors about 2.1 m high. Every person at true adult proportions (head about one-eighth of height); camera at adult eye level unless the shot says otherwise.

nw-8.5-candles-v.location: Islington's Great Hall: rock walls, iron pillars running into the dark, a waterfall into a small rock-pool, hundreds of candles, a huge door of black flint set in silver tarnished almost black between two iron pillars.
nw-8.5-candles-v.keyframe: Wide and dark: the Great Hall lit only by the first few candles. The Angel Islington walks slowly between the iron pillars: a petite, curvy young woman, sweet-faced, evenly half Greek and half East Asian, pearl-grey eyes, long soft golden waves, a single length of thin sheer ancient gauze linen pinned at one shoulder with a plain gold pin, barefoot on the cold rock, no wings. Each candle beside her flickers into flame as she passes.
nw-8.5-candles-v.motion: The candles light themselves in a wave behind her until the hall glows. She kneels by the rock-pool, cups her hands, drinks, and closes her eyes for a moment as if in blessing.
nw-8.5-candles-v.why: The angel's first appearance: candles lighting with no hand is pure video, and her serenity here makes 20.3 hit.
nw-8.5-candles-v.scale: Scale: People and creatures: the Angel Islington 1.55 m. Iron pillars about 8 m tall; the black flint door about 4 m tall, more than twice a person's height; candles stand knee- to waist-high; the rock-pool about 2 m across. Every person at true adult proportions (head about one-eighth of height); camera at adult eye level unless the shot says otherwise.

nw-9.2-gap-v.location: A Central Line platform at night, a few late passengers, posters for films and underwear, the recorded voice: Mind the Gap.
nw-9.2-gap-v.keyframe: Medium-wide on a platform with no train in: Hunter (tall Asian woman, long braid, thin dappled suede top, leather leggings, quarterstaff in hand) has turned sharply toward the platform edge; over the edge a diaphanous ribbon of black smoke wells up and is coiling round a woman's ankle in black jeans and black sneakers at the front of the frame.
nw-9.2-gap-v.motion: The smoke, fast yet seeming to drift in slow motion, tightens round the ankle and drags the black-jeaned leg toward the edge; Hunter strikes the smoke again and again with her staff; a thin faraway scream; it lets go and slides back over the edge, leaving a pale bleached patch on the jeans where it touched.
nw-9.2-gap-v.why: The first monster of London Below, and the reason Aurie's jeans are bleached from here on.
nw-9.2-gap-v.scale: Scale: People and creatures: Hunter 1.78 m. About 3 m from the platform edge to the back wall; Tube carriage doors about 1.9 m high. Every person at true adult proportions (head about one-eighth of height); camera at adult eye level unless the shot says otherwise.

nw-9.4-carriage-v.location: A Central Line platform at night, a few late passengers, posters for films and underwear, the recorded voice: Mind the Gap.
nw-9.4-carriage-v.keyframe: Medium-wide on the platform: the marquis de Carabas (huge black dandy's coat, locs tied back) drums an intricate rhythm on the door of a dark, empty Tube carriage; behind him wait Aurie in her ruined sweater and jeans (mud to the knees, bleached pale patches on the jeans), Door (brown leather flying jacket, patchwork corset bodice) and Hunter (long braid, dappled suede, quarterstaff). The other carriages are lit; passengers get on and off, ignoring them.
nw-9.4-carriage-v.motion: The dark carriage door is pushed open six inches from inside: firelight, smoke and people glow through the gap, though the glass beside it still shows an empty dark car; an elderly bespectacled face peers out. Then the door slides fully open on straw, rushes, chickens and a blazing log fire.
nw-9.4-carriage-v.why: A medieval court inside a Tube carriage: the reveal is the whole joke of London Below.
nw-9.4-carriage-v.scale: Scale: People and creatures: the marquis de Carabas 1.88 m, about one head taller than Aurie; Aurie 1.65 m; Door 1.52 m, about half a head shorter than Aurie; Hunter 1.78 m, about half a head taller than Aurie. About 3 m from the platform edge to the back wall; Tube carriage doors about 1.9 m high. Every person at true adult proportions (head about one-eighth of height); camera at adult eye level unless the shot says otherwise.

nw-10.3-run-v.location: A museum storeroom: a dim hall crowded with junk, crates and statues on plinths.
nw-10.3-run-v.keyframe: Medium-wide: Mr Croup (thin, lank orange hair, graveyard grin, wrong black suit) sits at the base of a plinth on which Mr Vandemar (huge, blank face, raven-skull rings) stands posed like a statue; Door (brown leather flying jacket, short copper-lit hair) edges away from them toward a door, her hand clasped in Aurie's; Aurie, in her ruined sweater and jeans, is at her side.
nw-10.3-run-v.motion: Door bolts for the door, hand in hand with Aurie, and it opens at her touch; the two run through, seen from behind; Croup gives a man-sized cuckoo call and Vandemar throws back his bullet head and howls like a wolf, ghostly and feral, as the door swings shut.
nw-10.3-run-v.why: The traitor hint lands with a chase and two inhuman sounds.
nw-10.3-run-v.scale: Scale: People and creatures: Aurie 1.65 m; Door 1.52 m, about half a head shorter than Aurie; Mr Croup 1.68 m, about the same height as Aurie; Mr Vandemar 2.05 m, about one and a half heads taller than Aurie. Plinths about 1 m high, so a man standing on one has his head far above everyone else's; crates chest-high. Every person at true adult proportions (head about one-eighth of height); camera at adult eye level unless the shot says otherwise.

nw-10.6-light-v.location: The museum's exhibition hall during the Angels over England party: guests in evening dress, drinks, and on a stage the Angelus, an enormous carved cathedral door.
nw-10.6-light-v.keyframe: Wide from behind the party crowd: on the stage Door (brown leather flying jacket, short copper-lit hair, dirty-faced) holds Aurie's hand with her left hand and touches the Angelus, the enormous carved cathedral door, with her right; Aurie, in her ruined sweater and jeans, grubby among the evening dresses, stands beside her, seen from behind.
nw-10.6-light-v.motion: The Angelus opens and light floods the room like industrial-strength fireworks; guests shield their eyes, then stare, frozen in awe; the two women walk into the light and vanish; the door closes and the light show is over.
nw-10.6-light-v.why: The gateway to the angel: a moment of pure magic in front of a London crowd.
nw-10.6-light-v.scale: Scale: People and creatures: Aurie 1.65 m; Door 1.52 m, about half a head shorter than Aurie. The stage is about 1 m high; the Angelus is about 5 m tall, nearly three times a person's height. Every person at true adult proportions (head about one-eighth of height); camera at adult eye level unless the shot says otherwise.

nw-11.3-figurine-v.location: A dank cellar: dripping water, rustling maggots, one lantern.
nw-11.3-figurine-v.keyframe: Medium shot by lantern light: Mr Croup (thin, pallid, lank orange hair, faded china-blue eyes, wrong black suit) cradles a small glazed T'ang dynasty pottery figurine in both hands, flushed and adoring, tongue flicking out like a snake's; Mr Vandemar (huge, blank face) stands behind him in the shadows.
nw-11.3-figurine-v.motion: Croup turns it over and over with a baby's innocent smile, then grins far too wide and crushes its head in his teeth, chewing wildly; the china grinds to a powder that dusts his chin; Vandemar watches, blank.
nw-11.3-figurine-v.why: Croup's nature in one image: he loves beautiful things in order to destroy them.
nw-11.3-figurine-v.scale: Scale: People and creatures: Mr Croup 1.68 m; Mr Vandemar 2.05 m, about one and a half heads taller than Mr Croup. The ceiling is about 2.3 m, low over a tall man's head; the figurine fits in two cupped hands (about 20 cm). Every person at true adult proportions (head about one-eighth of height); camera at adult eye level unless the shot says otherwise.

nw-13.1-quarterstaff-v.location: A marsh in thick yellow fog at the foot of the Black Friars' bridge rising out of the mist; muddy water.
nw-13.1-quarterstaff-v.keyframe: Medium-wide in thick yellow fog: Brother Sable (tall powerful Black British friar, shaved head, black Dominican habit, a quarterstaff as tall as he is) has just pushed Aurie, in her ruined sweater and jeans, back into the muddy water with his staff; she sits in the mud. Hunter (long braid fading to bronze, dappled suede, leather leggings) steps past her, staff raised; Door (brown leather flying jacket, short copper-lit hair) watches from the bank.
nw-13.1-quarterstaff-v.motion: Hunter and Sable fight with quarterstaves, wood clacking in the mist; his staff hits her midriff and she stumbles, a feint; as he comes in close her staff slams into the backs of his knees and he falls into the mud; she rests the tip of her staff on the back of his neck. Aurie watches from the mud, calm.
